children.text: Female employees will receive a financial assistance of ₹4,200 in the third month of pregnancy and ₹2,800 in the eighth month of pregnancy as maternity benefit.
Male employees will receive a financial assistance of ₹3,000 as paternity leave after the birth of the child.

schemeContent.benefits_md:
- Female employees will receive a financial assistance of ₹4,200 in the third month of pregnancy and ₹2,800 in the eighth month of pregnancy as maternity benefit.
- Male employees will receive a financial assistance of ₹3,000 as paternity leave after the birth of the child.
schemeContent.briefDescription: Chhattisgarh State Government started a scheme "Safai Karmakar Prasuti Sahayata Yojana" for unorganized worker on 11 March 2015.

children.text: Labor Department of Chhattisgarh State started this scheme "Safai Karmakar Prasuti Sahayata Yojana" for unorganized worker on  11 March 2015. The main objective of the scheme to empower unorganized worker by providing financial assistance for Maternity Assistance.

schemeContent.detailedDescription_md: Labor Department of Chhattisgarh State started this scheme &quot;Safai Karmakar Prasuti Sahayata Yojana&quot; for unorganized worker on  11 March 2015. The main objective of the scheme to empower unorganized worker by providing financial assistance for Maternity Assistance.
